chunks: To God belong the End and the Beginning.

key_terms.الْآخِرَةُ: The End, the final return or afterlife
key_terms.الْأُولَى: The Beginning, the initial creation or origin
key_terms.لِلَّهِ: To God, indicating exclusive ownership or dominion

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that 'To God belong the End and the Beginning' in Surah An-Najm?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to affirm Allah's absolute dominion over both the temporal world (al-dunya) and the hereafter (al-akhirah), rejecting any shared sovereignty. It reinforces the concept of Tawhid al-Rububiyyah, highlighting that all origins and returns are solely attributed to the Divine, a theme central to the narrative of Surah An-Najm regarding the Prophet's night journey and divine revelation.
